text_en: Data released by the Ministry of Commerce on the 3rd showed that from January to July this year, China's total services imports and exports reached RMB 4,446.71 billion, up 8.3% year on year. The data showed that services exports were RMB 1,773.23 billion, up 17.1%, and services imports were RMB 2,673.48 billion, up 3.2%. The services trade deficit was RMB 900.25 billion, narrowing by RMB 176.33 billion year on year. Specifically, travel and transport services exports contributed over 50% to overall services export growth. From January to July, travel services exports were RMB 263.61 billion, up 27.7%, and transport services exports were RMB 363.23 billion, up 27.1%.
